claims.object_text: identified as a hub gene across multiple algorithms
claims.quote: Six hub genes, SYP, SYN1, RAB3A, SLC17A7, SYN2, and STXBP1, were consistently identified across all algorithms.
All six genes were significantly downregulated in glioma, as confirmed by GEO datasets (area under the curve [AUC]: 0.787-0.802) and clinical qRT-PCR validation.

claims.object_text: low expression associated with activation of the cell cycle, complement and coagulation cascades, and immune dysregulation
claims.quote: GSEA revealed that low expression of these genes was associated with activation of the cell cycle, complement and coagulation cascades, and immune dysregulation.

claims.object_text: enriched in tumor-propagating cell (TPC)-like tumor cells and reduced in glioma core regions
claims.quote: Single-cell analyses indicated that these hub genes were primarily enriched in tumor-propagating cell (TPC)-like tumor cells but were markedly reduced in glioma core regions.
